# Workbook fixtures (generated by `npm run template`)

| File | Mode | Expected | What it contains |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marginpulse-sample-workbook.xlsx` | replace | accepted | Canonical sample: every sheet, scenario A data. Re-importing it unchanged is a no-op. |
| `valid/merge-threshold-40.xlsx` | merge | accepted | Merge mode: only merchant_policies, with the Downtown limit raised to 40 min. After commit, the scenario-A rush becomes NO_ACTION. |
| `invalid/missing-sheet.xlsx` | replace | rejected | Replace mode without the campaigns sheet. |
| `invalid/wrong-types.xlsx` | replace | rejected | Text in an integer column and a 3-decimal dollar amount. |
| `invalid/duplicate-ids.xlsx` | replace | rejected | Two rows with campaign_id cmp-syn-4081. |
| `invalid/orphan-reference.xlsx` | replace | rejected | A report pointing at an unknown campaign. |
| `invalid/invalid-status.xlsx` | replace | rejected | A configured_status that is not in the allowed list. |
| `invalid/formula-cell.xlsx` | replace | rejected | A formula in daily_budget_usd (formulas are never evaluated). |
| `invalid/excel-date-cell.xlsx` | replace | rejected | An Excel date cell instead of ISO-8601 text (timezone would be ambiguous). |
| `invalid/stale-revision.xlsx` | replace | rejected | Campaign cmp-syn-4081 at version 11 while the simulator holds 12. |
| `valid/campaigns-read-only.csv` | merge (CSV, entity=campaigns) | accepted | Sets cmp-syn-4081 permissions to READ only → the next rush is BLOCKED_MISSING_PERMISSION. |
